At β=1/2 cancellation yields finite limiting curvature α^{-2}(λ²e^λ/2−3/4) and unique λ0≈0.814884. At β=1, direct differentiation at x=1 gives α^{-2}(λ²exp(−1+λ exp(−1/2))−2), which is positive at λ=2 (~2.94984); the unique crossing is λ1≈1.485829. This independently disproves any β-only global theorem. Symbolic differentiation of the published log-density for β=1 and exact λ=2 positivity were verified; the asymptotic powers provide a separate analytic proof.
